items.exampleEn: Teachers met to address an issue raised by parents.
items.exampleZh: 老師們開會處理家長提出的一個問題。

items.exampleEn: The team's place in the league is at stake in this game.
items.exampleZh: 這場比賽攸關這支隊伍在聯盟中的地位。

items.exampleEn: Bear this in mind before you sign anything.
items.exampleZh: 在簽任何東西之前，要牢記這一點。

items.exampleEn: The bridge is raised by means of a large motor.
items.exampleZh: 這座橋是藉由一具大型馬達升起來的。

items.exampleEn: It took him a long time to come to terms with failing the exam.
items.exampleZh: 他花了很長的時間才接受考試沒過的事實。

items.exampleEn: The program helps students gain insight into different jobs.
items.exampleZh: 這個計畫幫助學生深入了解不同的工作。

items.exampleEn: His careless comment gave rise to a long argument.
items.exampleZh: 他一句不經意的話引起了一場漫長的爭論。

items.sentenceEn: With the championship at stake, the players trained every day.
items.sentenceZh: 由於攸關冠軍，球員們每天都在練習。

items.audioEn: Bear in mind that the museum is closed on Mondays, so plan your visit for another day.
items.audioZh: 請記住博物館星期一休館，所以要安排在別天參觀。
options: Buy tickets online before you go
Bring a student card for a discount

items.sentenceEn: Online shopping has given rise to new kinds of jobs.
items.sentenceZh: 網路購物帶動了新類型的工作。

items.sentenceEn: She slowly came to terms with moving to a new country.
items.sentenceZh: 她慢慢接受了搬到新國家的事實。

items.stemEn: The heavy stones were moved ____ ropes and logs.
items.stemZh: 那些沉重的石頭是藉由繩子和圓木搬動的。

items.stemEn: The manager promised to ____ raised by several customers.
items.stemZh: 經理承諾會處理幾位顧客提出的問題。

items.passageEn: When the city opened a new shopping center, it gave rise to serious traffic problems in nearby streets. Residents complained for months before the council agreed to deal with the problem. Officials first tried to gain insight into drivers' habits by means of a survey and cameras at busy corners. They found that most drivers were simply looking for somewhere to park. With local businesses and residents' quality of life at stake, the council quickly added more parking spaces and a free bus. Traffic on weekends is now much smoother.
items.passageZh: 市政府開了一座新的購物中心後，附近街道出現了嚴重的交通問題。居民抱怨了好幾個月，市議會才同意處理這個問題。官員先藉由問卷調查和繁忙路口的攝影機，深入了解駕駛人的習慣。他們發現，大部分的駕駛只是在找地方停車。由於攸關當地商家和居民的生活品質，市議會很快增加了停車位，並開設免費公車。現在週末的交通順暢多了。

questions.questionZh: 交通問題是怎麼引起的？
options: 市議會把附近幾條街改成了單行道
附近蓋了一座新的購物中心

questions.questionZh: 官員調查後發現了什麼？
options: 附近的居民大多不喜歡開車出門
很多駕駛是從外地來購物的觀光客
大部分駕駛在找停車位
路口的攝影機常常拍不清楚車牌

items.promptZh: 這次旅行讓我更深入了解當地的文化。
referenceEn: This trip helped me gain insight into the local culture.
On this trip, I was able to gain insight into the local culture.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「深入了解」（例如 gain insight into the local culture 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 helped me understand it better、gave me insight into it 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 helped、has helped 等）
「讓我」可寫，例如 helped me、I was able to 等

items.promptZh: 請記住，這份報告明天就要交。
referenceEn: Please bear in mind that this report is due tomorrow.
Bear in mind that the report must be handed in tomorrow.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「記住」（例如 bear in mind that 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 remember、keep in mind、note that this report is due tomorrow 等）
「明天就要交」可寫，例如 is due tomorrow、must be handed in tomorrow 等
句首加不加 Please 都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「冠軍攸關，球員們每天都在練習」不通順：「攸關」後須接受詞（攸關冠軍／事關冠軍）。建議「為了爭奪冠軍（冠軍在此一舉），球員們每天都在練習。」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：中譯改為「由於攸關冠軍，球員們每天都在練習。」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「agreed to address an issue that many saw as urgent」所指的是前文已提到的交通問題（特指），用不定冠詞 an 不自然，應為 address the issue；passageZh 也譯成「這個…問題」，與英文不一致。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：該句改為 "before the council agreed to deal with the problem."（指前文的交通問題），中譯同步為「市議會才同意處理這個問題。」
